Commentary.Commentary: Welcome back! The players concerned are back on the field. Chamari Athapaththu and Harshitha Madavi are the openers for Sri Lanka Women. Eden Carson to start proceedings...
... CHASE TIME ...
Right then,  the target for Sri Lanka Women is a daunting 163 to book a seat in the semis. Can they do it? We shall find out soon. Stay tuned for the second essay.

Amelia Kerr (66) comes up for a quick chat. She is delighted to be amongst the run-scorers and she really enjoyed her time with Suzie Bates. She adds a target was on the back of their minds and feels that with the pitch keeping a bit low, it's a handy total on the board. Also adds that the ball was keeping up-and-down and she is looking forward to bowling on this track as this is going to help the spinners a lot.

In a must-win game, Sri Lanka Women didn't turn up on the field. They bowled decently but their fielding was mediocre. A few catches were dropped and we saw plenty of misfields as well. In the last five overs, 46 runs came and that helped New Zealand Women reach a competitive total.

Fantastic batting show from the White Ferns! They were right on the money with their approach and made full use of the Powerplay with Bernadine Bezuidenhout playing a handy knock. After her departure, the pair of Suzie Bates and Amelia Kerr joined forces and never let the tempo down. The duo combined for a century stand and paved way for a strong total on the board.
Loopy delivery following Sophie Devine to her leg, She looks to heave this out of the park but misses out. This goes through her legs and they run 3 runs as the fielder at short fine leg misfields.

OUT! Run out! Devine goes hard at this one and drags it through mid-wicket. They attempt the second run and the throw comes to the bowler. Inoka takes the bails off and appeals. The third umpire is referred and Kerr is found inches short of the crease. End of a wonderful knock. Maddy Green is the new batter.
Appeal for a run out...
Flighted around middle, Sophie Devine walks down the track and smashes this towards deep mid-wicket for a couple
Sophie Devine is in next. Three balls left in the innings.

OUT! STUMPED! Inoka Ranaweera takes all the pace off this one and tosses it up around off. Suzie Bates gives a premeditated charge down the track, swings her bat early and misses the ball completely. Anushka Sanjeewani does the rest and Bates departs after playing a fine knock.
Commentary.Howout: st Anushka Sanjeewani b Inoka Ranaweera

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller around middle, Suzie Bates smashes this in the air towards wide long on for a couple.
Slow loopy delivery around the pads, Suzie Bates looks to play across the line but misses.
Inoka Ranaweera to bowl the final over.
Flighted around pads, Amelia Kerr thrashes this towards fine leg for a couple. 12 coming from the over!
Tossed up around off, Amelia Kerr drives this hard but the fielder at mid off fields well with a full stretch dive to keep it down to a couple.
FOUR! A gift to her from Chamari Athapaththu and the Kiwi all-rounder pounces to smash this for a boundary. Full toss around off, Amelia Kerr has lofted this over the mid off fielder for a boundary.
Tossed up around middle, Amelia Kerr lofts this towards deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs. The century stand comes up!
On a length around middle, Suzie Bates pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Flat around middle, Amelia Kerr pushes this to long on for a single.
Chamari Athapaththu has decided to continue...
Flat around off, Amelia Kerr has tapped this to cover-point for a single.
Full around off, Suzie Bates drills this to long on for a single.

FOUR! Inside edge and it runs away for a boundary behind the stumps. Suzie Bates continues her good form as she smashes another half century, her 25th in this format. Flighted around leg, Suzie Bates opens up to give it a big heave but gets an inside edge that runs towards the fence at fine leg.
Fuller one around middle, Amelia Kerr slogs this towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Flighted outside off, Amelia Kerr has driven this to sweeper cover as they run a couple more.
Tossed up around middle, Suzie Bates has clubbed this to long on for a single.
Fifty for the Kiwi all-rounder Amelia Kerr as she has nudged this flat one towards deep square leg for a couple. A fine knock so far. Can she close the innings well?
Tossed up outside off, Suzie Bates follows this and shuffles across the stumps as she lofts this to deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! Misfield and Nilakshi de Silva concedes a boundary. Suzie Bates uses her feet and hammers it down to long on. The fielder runs across but fails to pick it up and the ball touches the fence.
Flatter around middle, Amelia Kerr has smashed this to deep mid-wicket for yet another single.
On a shortish length around off, Suzie Bates pulls it flat towards deep mid-wicket for a single.

Achini Kulasuriya seems to have hurt her bowling arm. She immediately clutched it after delivering the last ball. Achini is in immense pain. Could be a dislocation. The physio runs out. Bad news, Achini Kulasuriya is being stretchered off the field. The only bowler to pick a wicket in this match so far is exiting the scene. Chamari Athapaththu to complete the over...
Full and wide outside off, Suzie Bates looks to open the face of her blade but misses any connection to it. Achini Kulasuriya is feeling some discomfort around her shoulder.
Achini Kulasuriya (2-0-14-1) returns to bowl at the death.
Flatter around the pads, Amelia Kerr milks this to the left of fine leg for a couple.
Run out chance, missed! Tossed up around middle, Amelia Kerr places this wide of deep mid-wicket for a couple. Suzie Bates gets lucky as Sugandika Kumari fails to score a direct hit at her end.
Full around middle, Amelia Kerr floats this to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Full and wide towards off, Amelia Kerr has guided this to short third man for no run.
Sugandika Kumari follows Suzie Bates as she makes room by shuffling towards the leg side. She gets a faint edge as this runs down through the legs of the keeper for a single.
Flatter one outside off, Suzie Bates gives it a charge and smashes this back to the bowler.
Short and on the leg peg. Amelia Kerr mistimes the pull towards the vacant deep mid-wicket region for a couple. 12 from the over and New Zealand Women are marching towards a big total.
FOUR! SMOKED! Full and outside off. Amelia Kerr advances and goes through with the shot as she clubs it over the bowler, down the ground toward long off, for a boundary.
Tad short and around off. Suzie Bates heaves it down to long on for a run.
Full on the middle and leg line. Amelia Kerr works it to deep mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Shot! Shortish and around off. Amelia Kerr uses her feet and slaps it through the extra cover region as the ball races to the fence for a boundary.
Pulls the length back and bowls just outside off. Amelia Kerr charges down and bunts it to covers.
Oshadi Ranasinghe is back on. 0 for 15 from her 2 overs so far.
Tossed up on the stumps. Amelia Kerr works it to the deep mid-wicket region for a single. 27 runs in the last three overs.
Slower, and turns away after pitching around middle. Suzie Bates covers it well and nudges it to square leg for one.
Full and on the leg peg. Amelia Kerr nudges it to short mid-wicket for one.
Another two. Flighted and around leg, Kerr plays a conventional sweep towards deep backward square leg and scampers back for the second run. 100 comes up!
Well played! Loopy and full, around leg, Amelia Kerr goes down and across before paddling it towards fine leg for two runs.
Wide! Inoka serves a full ball down the leg side, Kerr tries to sweep but misses.

DROPPED! Slower through the air, full and around off. Suzie Bates advances and hits it high up in the air behind the bowler. Nilakshi de Silva, at mid on, reacts to her left but puts down a simple catch. She gets hit on the chin as the ball goes through her hands. Suzie Bates gets a lifeline here. Catching has been abysmal from Sri Lanka Women! The 50-run stand comes up.
Inoka Ranaweera comes back to bowl her third over. None for 13 so far.
Floated outside off. Suzie Bates uses her feet and drags it from outside off and down to long on for a single to end the over. 10 from the over!
Full and turning in. Amelia Kerr flicks it down to long on for one.
Floated outside off. Amelia Kerr drives it crisply to the cover fielder.
FOUR MORE! Drops it short and on the leg peg. Amelia Kerr goes back and pulls it nicely through the deep backward square leg region for another boundary in the over.
Very full and outside off. Amelia Kerr squeezes it to the point fielder.

FOUR! Fine footwork! Tossed up outside off. Amelia Kerr uses her feet and drives it elegantly in the gap between the extra cover and mid-off fielders as the ball races through to the fence for a boundary.
Full again on the leg peg. Amelia Kerr nudges it toward deep mid-wicket for a single to end the over and retain the strike.
Full on the stumps. Suzie Bates shuffles across and whips it to deep square leg for one.
FOUR! Into the gap! Low full toss on off. Suzie Bates gets down and works it through the deep square leg region for a boundary. They are looking to play everything on the leg side.
Shortish around off. Suzie Bates goes back and pulls it to short mid-wicket.
Drifting on the pads. Amelia Kerr clips it in front of deep mid-wicket for a single.
Bowls it full and on the stumps. Suzie Bates uses her feet and works it to mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter and a bit short around off. Suzie Bates goes back and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Short and around off. Amelia Kerr swats it down to long on for a single.
Almost drags it on! Loopy and full, outside off, Amelia tries to sweep but gets an under edge. It beats the stumps by a whisker.
Slips one down the leg side, Kerr walks forward to flick but misses. She is rapped on the pads.

Shout for an lbw! Not given and Chamari Athapaththu takes the DRS after consulting her keeper. Slower through the air on the leg peg. Amelia Kerr stays back and looks to work it to the onside, misses, and wears it on the pad. DRS time. The ball is missing the leg stump, Ball Tracking confirms and Amelia Kerr can continue.
Flatter and quicker, turns in a tad bit. Amelia Kerr hangs back and plays it down onto the pitch at the last moment, just near the flap of the back pad.

Drinks break. It's been a good start from New Zealand Women! They utilized the field restriction superbly and then despite losing Bernadine Bezuidenhout, the tempo of the innings has not gone down. Sri Lanka Women have been poor on the field, dropping catches and committing misfields. They need to pull up their socks in the next phase. Chamari Athapaththu to bowl after the mini-break.
Tossed up around middle, Amelia Kerr leans and nudges this to mid-wicket for a single.
On a length around middle, Suzie Bates pulls it hard towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Suzie Bates gets a leading edge towards the left of the bowler. It pops out but lands safely.
Slower around middle, Amelia Kerr pushes this towards short mid-wicket for a single. The fielder fumbles but they decide not to risk another run off a misfield.
Flighted around middle, Suzie Bates pushes this to mid on for a single.
Flatter around off, Amelia Kerr smashes this off the back foot towards mid on and they run a single.
Inoka Ranaweera to bowl the 10th over of the innings. None for 8 from her one over so far.
Flighted around middle, Amelia Kerr has pushed this towards the on side for a single at mid-wicket to end the 9th over.
Tossed up around middle, Suzie Bates has chipped this towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Flighted around middle, Amelia Kerr has nudged this for a single towards short fine leg.
Flatter around middle, Suzie Bates smashes this towards cow corner for a single.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries from the bat of Suzie Bates. Flatter and shorter, wide outside off, Suzie Bates cuts it late and finds the fence behind the wickets towards third man.
FOUR! Off-break turning in towards the batter, Suzie Bates has smashed this off the backfoot for a boundary towards deep mid-wicket.
Kavisha Dilhari comes into the attack.
Flighted outside off, Suzie Bates walks down the track to push this towards long on for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Suzie Bates looks to play the reverse sweep but fails to connect.
Flighted around off, Amelia Kerr pushes this through point for a single to rotate the strike.
Tossed up around off, turning in, Amelia Kerr has blocked this out.
Full and wide outside off, Suzie Bates drives this to sweeper cover for a single.
Loopy delivery outside off, Suzie Bates smashes this to the fielder at short mid-wicket.
Oshadi Ranasinghe is back on. Her first over went for 12 overs.
Tossed up around off, Suzie Bates has slog-swept this towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
On a length outside off, Amelia Kerr has cut this towards point for a single.
Flatter outside off, Suzie Bates punches this towards covers for a single.
Flighted outside off, Amelia Kerr pushes this towards sweeper cover for a single.
FOUR! Lucky escape for Amelia Kerr as she edges one sharply underneath the keeper for a boundary behind the stumps.
Flighted outside off, Amelia Kerr pushes it towards extra cover for no run.
Powerplay is done. It's been a strong start from New Zealand Women but losing Bernadine Bezuidenhout is a big blow. Inoka Ranaweera comes into the attack. One slip in place...
On a length outside off, Amelia Kerr places this towards point for a single. 47 for 1 in the Powerplay.
Full and wide outside off, Amelia Kerr looks to drive but misses out.
Amelia Kerr comes in next, at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT! End of a quickfire knock from Bernadine Bezuidenhout.​ Achini Kulasuriya serves it on a length around off, Bernadine Bezuidenhout attempts for an aerial shot but there is some extra bounce and she mistimes it in the air towards mid off. Chamari Athapaththu stretches forward and low to complete the catch. Achini Kulasuriya is pumped up and it's a crucial breakthrough for Sri Lanka Women!
Commentary.Howout: c Chamari Athapaththu b Achini Kulasuriya

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Full toss, given the treatment it deserved as Bernadine Bezuidenhout has dispatched this for a boundary. Freebie on middle, Bernadine Bezuidenhout has slogged this towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Short and wide outside off, Bernadine Bezuidenhout cuts this through point for a couple.
On a length angling in towards the pads, Suzie Bates has pushed this towards mid on for a single.
Achini Kulasuriya is back on.
Full and around off. Suzie Bates gets down and sweeps it along the turf to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller on off. Bernadine Bezuidenhout lofts it on the bounce to Chamari Athapaththu at mid-off and takes a single.
FOUR! BANG! Malsha Shehani fires it on the leg peg. Bernadine Bezuidenhout paddles it with ease past the fielder at short fine leg as the ball runs down to the ropes for a boundary.
DROPPED! Bernadine Bezuidenhout shimmies down and takes it on the full, whips it straight into the hands of Harshitha Madavi who spills this one. The batters complete a couple.
Full and on the middle and leg stump line. Bernadine Bezuidenhout sweeps it to the square leg fielder.
Floated around off, slogged to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Malsha Shehani comes into the attack.

FOUR! Bernadine Bezuidenhout ends the over with a boundary! Full and on the leg peg. Bernadine Bezuidenhout sweeps it nicely past the backward square leg fielder as the ball races through the gap and into the fence for four.
Full and outside off. Suzie Bates sweeps it along the carpet to deep mid-wicket for a single.

Run out appeal! Full and on the stumps. Suzie Bates works it down to long on for a couple. The throw comes to the bowler who dislodges the bails. They appeal and the third umpire comes in. The replays find Bernadine Bezuidenhout safe.
Short and outside off. Suzie Bates cuts it to the cover-point region.
Tossed up on middle and leg. Bernadine Bezuidenhout clips this through mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! SMOKED! Full and on off. Bernadine Bezuidenhout gets down on one knee and clubs it to the deep mid-wicket region for a boundary. The ball bounces in front of the fielder in the deep and goes over her head.

Fuller and around off, Bates defends it back to the bowler.

WIDE! Sliding down the leg side. Bernadine Bezuidenhout leaves it alone as the umpire gives it a wide.

A MIX-UP in the middle but Bernadine Bezuidenhout survives. Fuller on the leg peg. Bernadine Bezuidenhout whips it to the square-leg fielder. Bernadine Bezuidenhout is halfway down to take a run but is sent back by Bates. A poor throw from the fielder as the ball goes over the keeper and Bernadine Bezuidenhout gets back in.
Tosses it up around off. Bernadine Bezuidenhout drives it to the cover fielder. Three dots in a row.
Shortish and sliding down the leg side. Bernadine Bezuidenhout gets down and sweeps it to the short fine-leg fielder for none.
Fuller on off. Bernadine Bezuidenhout prods forward and defends it to covers.

FOUR! BANG! Short of a length around off. Suzie Bates charges down the track and pulls it along the carpet to the deep square leg region for a boundary. Excellent SHOT and Suzie Bates is up and running.
Fuller length around off. Suzie Bates prods forward and defends it back to the bowler.
Back of a length angling on the pads. Bernadine Bezuidenhout tucks it to the square leg region for a single.
Full-length delivery again on the middle stump. Suzie Bates works it through mid-wicket for a single.
Short of a length angling away outside off. Suzie Bates charges down and tries to cut but gets a bottom edge toward the keeper.
Achini Kulasuriya starts off with a full ball on off. Suzie Bates drives it back at the bowler.
Who will bowl from the opposite end? Achini Kulasuriya will run in next...
A low full toss on the stumps. Suzie Bates leans into it and drives it nicely down to long on for a single.
Fuller and straighter on off. Bernadine Bezuidenhout presses forward and gets an inside edge to the onside for one.
Fuller, and on the leg peg. Suzie Bates works it toward mid-wicket for a single and gets off the mark.
Drifts it on the leg peg. Bernadine Bezuidenhout nudges it to the mid-wicket region for one.
FOUR! Bernadine Bezuidenhout is away! Tosses up outside off. Bernadine Bezuidenhout leans into it and drives it nicely through the cover-point region for a boundary to get off the mark.
Sugandika Kumari starts off with an arm ball sliding in on the middle stump line. Bernadine Bezuidenhout goes back and bunts it to covers.

Right then, all the pre-match formalities are done and we are ready to get underway! The Lankan Women quickly get into a huddle before spreading on the ground. Suzie Bates and Bernadine Bezuidenhout are the openers for New Zealand Women. Sugandika Kumari will bowl the first over. One slip in place. Here we go...
The match officials and players from both sides have lined up for the National Anthems. We start with the anthem of Sri Lanka followed by that of New Zealand.

Sri Lanka Women (Playing XI) - Harshitha Madavi, Chamari Athapaththu (C), Vishmi Gunaratne, Anushka Sanjeewani (WK), Nilakshi de Silva, Kavisha Dilhari (in for Ama Kanchana), Malsha Shehani, Oshadi Ranasinghe, Sugandika Kumari, Inoka Ranaweera, Achini Kulasuriya.

New Zealand Women (Playing XI) - Suzie Bates, Bernadine Bezuidenhout (WK), Georgia Plimmer, Amelia Kerr, Sophie Devine (C), Maddy Green, Hannah Rowe, Lea Tahuhu, Jess Kerr, Eden Carson, Fran Jonas (in for Molly Penfold).
TOSS - Sophie Devine has won the toss and New Zealand Women will bat first.

New Zealand Women, on the other hand, find themselves on the brink of exit from the mega event. They were bowled out for under 80 in their opening two games and their run rate took a massive beating. The White Ferns came back strongly against the Bangladesh Women and won comprehensively by 71 runs.  They will want to get over the line today by a huge margin to boost their net run rate and give themselves an outside chance of qualification. Can New Zealand Women beat the Sri Lanka Women and keep their chances alive in the tournament or will Sri Lanka Women roll them over and book their tickets for the semis? We shall find out together. Toss and other updates coming up shortly. Stay tuned!

Hello and a warm welcome to our coverage of Match 17 in the ICC Women's T20 World Cup, 2023. The Sri Lanka Women are taking on the New Zealand Women at the Boland Park in Paarl. They are placed at number 2 in the points table in Group A with 2 wins in three games. The Islanders won their opening two games before being thrashed by Australian Women with a huge margin of 10 wickets. A win today will certainly get them through to the semis and the Lankan Women will be up for the challenge.
...MATCHDAY...

It is now time for match 17 in the ICC Women's T20 World Cup 2023, which sees New Zealand Women take on Sri Lanka Women at Boland Park in Paarl. Sri Lanka Women find themselves second in Group 1 with two wins from their three games, whereas New Zealand Women are placed fourth with a solitary win from three matches. In terms of semi-final qualification, Sri Lanka Women are slightly better placed than New Zealand and a win would be enough for them to seal a semis spot provided South Africa lose to Australia. On the other hand, New Zealand Women need to win against Sri Lanka by a big margin and hope other results go their way. Sri Lanka Women come into this game on the back of a massive defeat at the hands of Australia in their previous game. Batting first, they could only manage 112 runs and were unable to defend a low total against the strong Australian side. Harshitha Madavi and Chamari Athapaththu have done the bulk of the scoring for them, but the duo will require support from the likes of Vishmi Gunaratne and Nilakshi de Silva in this important clash. In the bowling department, the onus will be on Oshadi Ranasinghe and Inoka Ranaweera, who have been their star performers. Malsha Shehani and Sugandika Kumari have been below par with the ball so far, and they will need to put in their best performance in this game. On the contrary, New Zealand Women got the better of Bangladesh in their last outing and registered their first win of the competition. In that game, a clinical effort from their batters helped them post 189 runs on the board. Their bowlers were equally good, and as a result, Bangladesh could only manage 118. Their batting struggled in the first two games, but it showed a much-needed improvement in their last game. Suzie Bates is their most experienced batter, and she, along with Sophie Devine and Bernadine Bezuidenhout, will be crucial to their team's chances. The trio of Eden Carson, Lea Tahuhu, and Amelia Kerr has starred for them with the ball so far, and they will need to step up to get their side over the line in this game. New Zealand Women hold the upper hand heading into this fixture, having won all nine previous meetings between these two sides. Will Sri Lanka Women manage to spring a surprise and take a huge step towards the semifinals, or will New Zealand Women secure a win and stay alive in the competition? We shall find out together.
